<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-error-codes.mjs from the G8Deck application (php artisan docs:error-codes). Do not edit by hand: re-run `node scripts/gen-error-codes.mjs`. -->

When something G8Deck does fails, the console tells you in plain words and
ends the message with two short labels:

```
Your server refused G8Deck's login. Code G8-E202 · Reference 7K2-QX9
```

- The **code** (`G8-E202`) says what kind of failure it was. It is the same
  every time that kind of failure happens, and it is what you look up on this
  page.
- The **reference** (`7K2-QX9`) belongs to this one incident. Give it to
  support and they can find the technical detail behind the message. The
  reference itself contains no data, and support can only look it up for your
  own organisation.

Codes are never reused and never renumbered, so a code you wrote down last
year still means the same thing. If you see a code that is not listed here,
your console is newer than this page — contact support with the code and the
reference.

| Code                | What it means                                |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| [G8-E101](#g8-e101) | It took too long                             |
| [G8-E201](#g8-e201) | The server could not be reached              |
| [G8-E202](#g8-e202) | The server refused G8Deck's login            |
| [G8-E301](#g8-e301) | The server's disk is full                    |
| [G8-E302](#g8-e302) | A plan or quota limit was reached            |
| [G8-E401](#g8-e401) | A domain name could not be looked up         |
| [G8-E402](#g8-e402) | The security certificate could not be issued |
| [G8-E403](#g8-e403) | An email could not be sent                   |
| [G8-E501](#g8-e501) | G8Deck stopped and said why                  |
| [G8-E502](#g8-e502) | Your application failed to start             |
| [G8-E503](#g8-e503) | Your application's build failed              |
| [G8-E900](#g8-e900) | Something went wrong on our side             |

## G8-E101

**It took too long.** This took too long and was stopped.

**What you can do**

1. Try again — a busy server often finishes on the second attempt.
2. Check that the server is not overloaded (CPU, memory, disk).

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E201

**The server could not be reached.** G8Deck couldn't reach your server.

**What you can do**

1. Check that the server is switched on and connected to the internet.
2. Check that its firewall allows SSH from G8Deck.
3. Try again in a few minutes — a server that has just been created can take a moment to accept connections.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E202

**The server refused G8Deck's login.** Your server refused G8Deck's login.

**What you can do**

1. Check that G8Deck's SSH key is still installed for the login user on the server.
2. If you changed the server's password or keys, reconnect the server in G8Deck.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E301

**The server's disk is full.** Your server has run out of disk space.

**What you can do**

1. Free some space on the server, or open Disk hygiene for the server in G8Deck.
2. Try again once space is available.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E302

**A plan or quota limit was reached.** This would go over a limit on your plan or quota.

**What you can do**

1. Read the message — it names the limit that was reached.
2. Free up something you no longer use, or ask your organisation's administrator to raise the limit or change plan.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E401

**A domain name could not be looked up.** A domain name could not be looked up.

**What you can do**

1. Check that the domain is spelled correctly.
2. Check that its DNS records point at your server — changes can take up to an hour to spread.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E402

**The security certificate could not be issued.** The security certificate for your domain could not be issued.

**What you can do**

1. Check that the domain points at your server and that port 80 is open.
2. Wait an hour before retrying — certificate authorities limit repeated attempts.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E403

**An email could not be sent.** An email could not be sent.

**What you can do**

1. Check the mail settings for your organisation.
2. Try again in a few minutes — mail providers sometimes refuse briefly.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E501

**G8Deck stopped and said why.** G8Deck stopped and explained why.

**What you can do**

1. Read the message — it says what stopped and what to change.
2. Make the change and try again.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the message is unclear or the change does not help. Quote the code and reference.

## G8-E502

**Your application failed to start.** Your application failed to start.

**What you can do**

1. Read the last lines from your application shown with the message — they come from your application, not from G8Deck.
2. Fix the cause (a wrong password or setting in the environment, a failing migration, a missing file) and deploy again.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E503

**Your application's build failed.** Your application's build failed.

**What you can do**

1. Read the last lines from the build shown with the message — they come from your project's own build commands.
2. Fix the build in your repository (or its build settings in G8Deck) and deploy again.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if the steps above do not help. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.

## G8-E900

**Something went wrong on our side.** Something went wrong on our side.

**What you can do**

1. Try again.
2. If it happens again, contact support with the code and reference.

**When to contact support:** Contact support if it happens more than once. Quote the code and reference shown with the message.
